label: Nature as metaphysical striving without conscious purpose
description: Arthur Schopenhauer's philosophical system was decisively shaped by grappling with "Naturphilosophie (Organic Nature as Unconscious Spirit)".
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Naturphilosophie (Organic Nature as Unconscious Spirit)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the 19th Century Divergences.
